title: DevOps Engineer GCP
description:
We’re Hiring: DevOps Manager – Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

We are looking for an experienced DevOps Manager to lead our GCP DevOps, reliability, observability, CI/CD, and FinOps initiatives.

Experience: 6\+ Years

Key Responsibilities:

\* Lead DevOps/Cloud engineering teams and incident management

\* Own GCP monitoring, logging, alerting, and SLOs

\* Drive GCP cost optimization and FinOps

\* Design \& govern CI/CD pipelines across GKE, Cloud Run, etc.

\* Implement Terraform/IaC and deployment automation

\* Manage GCP billing, budgets, and cost reporting

\* Partner with Security, Infrastructure, Development, and Finance teams

Must Have:

✅ 4\+ years of hands\-on GCP experience

✅ GKE, Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Cloud Build, Monitoring \& Logging

✅ Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform \& CI/CD

✅ Strong FinOps/cloud cost optimization experience

✅ Python/Bash/Go scripting

✅ 2\+ years of DevOps/SRE team leadership We’re Hiring: DevOps Manager – Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
